# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Identify the advertised specifications.
3. Document the test methods precisely.
4. Record the test results meticulously.
5. Highlight any discrepancies between the advertised specifications and the actual test results.
6. Use charts, graphs, and tables to visualize the discrepancies.
7. Include the date and time of the testing.
8. Record environmental conditions if applicable (temperature, humidity, etc.)
9. List the personnel conducting the tests.
10. Provide a step-by-step description of the testing procedure.
11. Describe any modifications made to the product before testing, if any.
12. Attach photographs or videos for visual evidence of the product and the testing process.
13. Note the version of software or firmware used if it impacts performance.
14. Report on the consistency of the performance issues across multiple samples.
15. Clearly state whether the product consistently fails to meet any specific advertised specifications.
16. Avoid ambiguous language; use precise and descriptive terms.
17. Explain why the failure
